Meet Lloyd, your ultimate AI companion that redefines what’s possible with artificial intelligence. Whether through video, voice, or text, Lloyd delivers the most advanced AI experience available today—powerful, intuitive, and always ready to assist.

Need real-time answers? Capture a video or just ask. Looking for the best coffee shop with a beach view? Lloyd’s Around Me mode finds the perfect spot instantly. Need help with homework, project planning, or breaking down complex tasks? Lloyd uses cutting-edge AI to assist with everything from solving math problems to organizing your next big project. Cooking a dish? Chef AI not only suggests creative ingredient substitutions but also guides you step by step and even reminds you to take the cake out of the oven. Exploring a new city? Lloyd maps out your day with top attractions, hidden gems, and the best local eats. Even in areas with low cell coverage, Lloyd keeps working when you need it most.

Lloyd is also the fastest live video messenger on the planet. Instantly share real moments with friends and family in one-on-one or group conversations—seamlessly combining text, voice, and video for a dynamic, real-time connection.

What else?

• Get expert assistance in the kitchen with Chef AI, providing step-by-step guidance and timely reminders so you never burn a dish.
• Use Around Me mode to simplify local area planning—find restaurants, activities, or secret spots nearby.
• Get help with homework, planning, and productivity tasks—Lloyd isn’t just about fun, it’s a serious tool for getting things done.
• Chat just like you would with ChatGPT or Claude—Lloyd works in text-only mode, voice mode, or video mode based on what suits you best.

Lloyd is powered by top-of-the-line AI models like ChatGPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 3.7, and more, ensuring you get the most advanced, accurate, and responsive assistance available.

Lloyd is built with privacy in mind. We do not use your messages, video, or interactions to train AI models. Your data stays yours.

Enjoy Lloyd’s powerful AI with no limits on usage in the free tier. No hidden restrictions—just a smart, capable assistant ready to help.

Get started today and experience AI that truly enhances your daily life!

Powered by EndlessAI’s Breakthrough Technology
Lloyd is brought to you by EndlessAI, a pioneer in next-generation AI innovation. EndlessAI’s unique technology bridges real-world experiences—whether through video, voice, or text—with the most advanced large language models available today. Our proprietary real-time processing and insight engines enable Lloyd to understand, adapt, and assist faster and more intelligently than anything else on the market.

What sets EndlessAI apart?
• True Visual Understanding — Lloyd doesn’t just see; it interprets, contextualizes, and provides real-time assistance.
• Resilient Connectivity — Designed to keep working even with spotty coverage, ensuring help is always available.
• Intelligent Interaction Layer — Enables Lloyd to dynamically guide you, suggest smarter next steps, and deliver meaningful insights.
• Privacy First — Your data stays yours. We never use your messages, video, or interactions to train AI models.

EndlessAI powers Lloyd to be more than just an assistant. It’s your bridge to a smarter, more connected life.
